content: Cold start dominated by model weight loading. Key optimizations: (1) Save pre-optimized ONNX graph to skip runtime optimization on startup, (2) Model warmup - run dummy inference before marking READY, (3) mmap for model weights to skip user/kernel copy, (4) Shared tensor memory across sessions. ONNX Runtime applies constant folding, node elimination, node fusion on load - can be skipped if model pre-optimized.
